card.name: Soft hyphen and odd fraction characters
card.fires_on: Responds to the invisible soft-hyphen character after a drug or class name, often in interaction tables. Also fires on a lone fraction sign like ½ and on the 'ifth' piece of 'one-fifth'.

modes.label: Soft hyphen after drug name
modes.description: An invisible soft-hyphen mark sits right after a drug name or class, standing in for an arrow or hyphen in interaction lists.

modes.label: Fraction wording
modes.description: A fraction character or the end of 'one-fifth' appears in a quantity phrase.
modes.example: Use about a <<½>> teaspoon of soap?

card.plain: It fires on a hidden hyphen mark after drug names in tables, and on a few fraction words like one-fifth.
